<cite ref="Onkelos Deuteronomy 24:15">Targ. O. Deut. XXIV, 15</cite>; a. fr.—Part. pass. <he>מָסִיר</he>; f. <cite ref="M01934"><he>מְסִירָא</he></cite>; pl. <cite ref="M01935"><he>מְסִירִין</he></cite>; <cite ref="M01934"><he>מְסִירָן</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Onkelos Numbers 3:9">Targ. Num. III, 9</cite>; a. fr.—[<cite ref="Targum Jerusalem, Genesis 16:5">Targ. Y. II, Gen. XVI, 5</cite> <he>מְסָרִין בידך</he>, a corrupt., prob. to be read: <he>מַסְרִית עלך</he>; cmp.

<cite ref="Bava Metzia 8b:10">B. Mets. 8ᵇ</cite> <he>מאן קא מ׳ ליה דליקני</he> who is there to deliver it to him, that he might take possession? <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yoma 3:7:8">Y. Yoma III, 40ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>אנא מָסֵר יתיה לך</he> I will transmit it (the pronunciation of the Tetragrammaton) to you.

<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 3:11">Koh. R. to III, 11</cite> [read:] <he>אית הכי בר נש דאִימְסוֹר ליה</he> is there a person here to whom I might communicate it?; <he>כד אתי מִימְסַר</he> when he was about to communicate it.
<cite ref="Kiddushin 12b:8">Kidd. 12ᵇ</cite> <he>דמ׳ מודעא וכ׳</he> who enters a protest against his own letter of divorce.

<cite ref="Berakhot 20a:5">Ber. 20ᵃ</cite> <he>הוו קא מָסְרֵי נפשייהו וכ׳</he> were ready to suffer martyrdom for the sanctification of the Name; <he>אנן לא מַסְרִינָן וכ׳</he> we are not ready to suffer &c.; a. fr.

senses.gloss: to be surrendered, transmitted; to surrender one’s self.
units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 79:11">Targ. Ps. LXXIX, 11</cite>; a. e.—

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 26a:23">Snh. 26ᵃ</cite> <he>מִימַּסְרֵי</he> have decided to surrender (to capitulate). Koh. R. l. c. <he>ולא קבל עליה מִימְּסֵר ליה מימסר</he> (some ed. <he>למימסר ליה</he>) he declined to have the Tetragrammaton transmitted to him (v. Y. Yoma l. c.).
